name: vivreal-db-explorer
description: Safe multi-tenant MongoDB querying and schema exploration for the Vivreal platform. The read-only MongoDB MCP server auto-connects at launch by sourcing CLUSTER_URL from AWS Secrets Manager (the secret named in vivreal-hq's private names file, so it needs no setup beyond VIVREAL_REPOS), so agents never have to ask the user for a connection string; /db-query and /db-schema carry a self-service connect fallback.
